title: Publication / retention policy
exit_criteria: only the project-authenticated CMP-4.7 publisher can create or revise policy
one deterministic current policy exists per lineage with append-only revision history
PRIVATE RESTRICTED and PUBLIC modes have explicit fail-closed field semantics
access and retention policy commitments are always nonzero
RESTRICTED/PUBLIC require an exact publication-manifest commitment
optional embargo and finite-or-indefinite retention windows are validated
current publication authorization fails closed for private inactive embargoed expired or noncanonical lineage
stale no-op duplicate and unauthorized mutations fail closed
raw metadata/results/evidence remain off-chain and no mutable URL is canonicalized
policy creates no storage deletion access correctness economic or governance authority
dedicated tests and mechanical verifier pass exact-head Level 1 qualification
intentionally_deferred: CMP-9 public/testnet storage enforcement and scientific demonstration
